media.alt: A 20 second vertical video. Owner Justin Myrick walks the empty, carpeted room in Orange Park where the Fore Motion Golf bays go, past the old service counters. The video cuts to a 3D concept view, labeled Concept, of a simulator bay with a golfer on the tee mat and spectator counters with stools in front, then back to Justin gesturing in the room. A deep green band at the bottom carries the lines Compete. Owner Justin Myrick walks the space. Leagues. Four bays. Leagues and events, four bays, as planned. Events. First access. with foremotiongolf.com, and the logo sits at the top. It ends on a deep green card: Join the Founders List, early access to launch events and leagues, foremotiongolf.com.

Owner Justin Myrick in a mint green polo walks down a long, empty carpeted room past old service counters, with the Fore Motion Golf logo at the top and a deep green band below that reads Compete. Owner Justin Myrick walks the space, and foremotiongolf.com.
